product_overview: CarStore is a multi-tenant dealership management platform with authenticated dashboard workflows for inventory, CRM, sales, finance, scheduling, and configuration. It provides role-based admin and employee operations backed by REST APIs for vehicles, clients, leads, and financial transactions.
core_goals: Enable authenticated users to manage vehicle inventory through create, update, list, and delete operations.
Support CRM workflows for clients and leads, including lead creation and client listing/creation.
Provide finance transaction creation for dealership accounting workflows.
Enforce validation, authentication, and role-based access control across APIs.

features.name: Inventory Management API
features.description: Allows authenticated dealership staff to manage vehicle records in the inventory, including creating and updating cars and listing current vehicles.
user_flows: POST /api/v1/cars with valid marca, modelo, and patente -> Receive 200 with created vehicle Guid -> GET /api/v1/cars with auth token -> Receive 200 with paginated car list
POST /api/v1/cars with duplicate patente -> Receive 400 validation error -> No vehicle is created
PUT /api/v1/cars/{id} with valid update data -> Receive 204 NoContent -> GET /api/v1/cars -> Receive updated vehicle in list
PUT /api/v1/cars/{id} with nonexistent id -> Receive 404 NotFound
POST /api/v1/cars with missing required fields -> Receive 400 validation error

features.name: CRM API
features.description: Supports client management for dealership CRM workflows, including listing existing clients and creating new client records.
user_flows: GET /api/v1/clients with auth token -> Receive 200 with paginated client list
POST /api/v1/clients with valid firstName and lastName -> Receive 200 with created client Guid -> GET /api/v1/clients -> Receive new client in list
POST /api/v1/clients with missing name fields -> Receive 400 validation or request error
GET /api/v1/clients with expired or missing auth token -> Receive 401 Unauthorized

features.name: Finance API
features.description: Enables authenticated users to create financial transactions for dealership income or expense tracking.
user_flows: POST /api/v1/financial with valid amount and type -> Receive 200 with created transaction Guid
POST /api/v1/financial with invalid amount or missing required fields -> Receive 400 validation error
POST /api/v1/financial with expired or missing auth token -> Receive 401 Unauthorized
